## Description

Risk a fixed fraction of equity or a fixed dollar amount per trade using stop distance to calculate quantity.

## Where it may fit

Any strategy with a defined invalidation level and disciplined risk budgeting.

## Vehicles

Stocks, ETFs, futures, FX and options (with payoff-aware sizing).

## Required data

Account equity, entry price, stop/exit rule, point value, fees, margin and current exposure.

## Caveats

Position sizing cannot rescue a strategy with negative expectancy; correlated positions need portfolio-level limits.
